architecture_audit.routing: Custom SPA routing via History API (window.location.pathname) managed in App.tsx. Includes basic locale detection.
architecture_audit.document_titles: Imperatively managed via document.title within component useEffect hooks.
architecture_audit.canonical_urls: Imperatively injected via document.createElement('link') within component useEffect hooks.
architecture_audit.json_ld: Imperatively injected via script tags within component useEffect hooks. Cleanup functions remove them on unmount.
architecture_audit.language_state: App.tsx currently identifies locale (e.g., 'id') via URL parsing. JurnalGuru.tsx has an internal UI-only state toggle.
architecture_audit.language_specific_routes: App.tsx routes explicitly check for `locale === 'id'`, establishing a foundation for `locale === 'en'` branch logic.
architecture_audit.metadata_abstraction: None. Metadata is hardcoded inside each component. Global SEO will require either duplicating this pattern or building an SEO wrapper component.
architecture_audit.sitemap_architecture: Static file at public/sitemap.xml. Will require manual updates for /en/ routes in the future.

hreflang_strategy_plan.mechanism: When EN pages are published, both ID and EN components must inject `<link rel='alternate' hreflang='id' href='...' />` and `<link rel='alternate' hreflang='en' href='...' />`.
hreflang_strategy_plan.x_default: The 'id' (Indonesian) URL will serve as the x-default since it is the primary language.
